title: Collection Development: Supplementary Exam, August 2018
instructions: ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A AND ANY OTHER TWO FROM SECTION B.

parts.text: Discuss the importance of budgeting in collection development.
Explain FIVE benefits of a collection development policy in a resource center.
Explain some of the benefits of a weeding a resource center's collection.

items.text: Section B ANSWER ANY TWO QUESTIONS (EACH CARRY 20 MARKS)
Discuss the merits and demerits of electronic collection in a library or a resource center.
Outline the various elements of a collection development policy.

parts.text: Discuss some of the factors you will consider when selecting information materials for a resource center.
Explain different methods resource centers can use to acquire information materials.

items.text: Automation has been a feature of acquisitions for a long time now, mainly in the form of automated acquisition systems. Discuss the merits of automated acquisition systems.
